    Interface DataFillOptions

    Options for Emap.dataFill — fill missing attribute values from adjacent features. Useful for cleaning gappy administrative-region datasets where some polygons lack a code/name field.

    Wraps mapshaper's -data-fill. Currently scoped to a single field per call (mapshaper's API limit).

    Example

    Runnable example association: buffer, check-geometry, clip-erase.

        weightField?: string;
    }

    Optionalcontiguous

    contiguous?: boolean

    Restrict fills so a contiguous block of features can only adopt one value (mapshaper's contiguous flag). Without it, isolated pockets within a region can pick up different fill values.
